## Summary

**Root Cause:** The test failures were caused by a malicious shared library (`/tmp/libwrite_corrupt.so`) that was being preloaded via `/etc/ld.so.preload`. This library was intercepting and corrupting file I/O operations (particularly `write` syscalls), which caused the test output to be garbled and led to apparent data corruption and value mismatches in the tests.

**Fix Applied:** 
1. Removed `/etc/ld.so.preload` which contained the path to the malicious library
2. Deleted the malicious library file `/tmp/libwrite_corrupt.so`

**Verification:** All the previously failing tests now pass (41 tests in the verification command, and 155 additional tests from the problem description also pass).
